extensions.title: Metadata and artwork
extensions.summary: Fills missing album art and artist photos from MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive.
detail: The server already fills missing album art from embedded pictures, then Cover Art Archive, and artist photos from the MusicBrainz artist portrait.
That job is part of the server. This record does not name a file to run.

extensions.title: Lyrics lookup
extensions.summary: Would fetch lyrics for tracks whose files have none.
detail: This build does not look up lyrics.
The record is a target a later package could name, and it would ask only for the lyrics grant.

extensions.title: Catalog search
extensions.summary: Would search a remote catalog and return matches as data.
detail: This build searches the library it already holds.
A later package could name this id and return remote matches as data.

extensions.title: Scrobblers
extensions.summary: Would send plays to a service the owner names.
detail: This build does not send plays.
A later package could name this id only after the owner consents to the named service.

extensions.title: Themes
extensions.summary: Would add theme packs as data on top of the built-in themes.
detail: Appearance already has the built-in themes.
A later package could name this id and add colours and names as data.

extensions.title: Home rows
extensions.summary: Would add a home row described as data.
detail: A later package could name this id and describe which albums a row shows.

extensions.title: Address style
extensions.summary: Addresses for artists, albums, tracks, movies and shows. This build uses unique name slugs.
detail: This build already addresses artists, albums, tracks, movies and shows with unique name slugs.
A slug address and an id address open the same page. The address bar shows the slug.
